title: Asset Fire Sales (and Purchases) in Equity Markets
one_line: Extreme mutual-fund outflows force predictable selling that depresses prices for about two quarters before reversing; front-running forced sales and purchases earned > 15%/yr (1980-2003).

findings.statement: Flow-driven trades are predictable from fund performance and holdings; price effects last ~2 quarters, then unwind.
Front-running strategy > 15% annual excess (mostly from inflows).

why.pattern: Institutional constraints: forced trading by funds facing flows.

reported_results.headline: Extreme mutual-fund outflows force predictable selling that depresses prices for about two quarters before reversing; front-running forced sales and purchases earned > 15%/yr (1980-2003).

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 3), not by the weekly pipeline.
